layer: actual installed SDK ETS AST of immutable baseline; physical rendering/target not run

nativeNodes.text:
Column({ space: 0 }) {
            Text('从系统文件中选择')
              .fontFamily(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_LABEL.fontFamily)
              .fontWeight(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_LABEL.fontWeight)
              .fontSize(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_LABEL.fontSizeFp)
              .lineHeight(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_LABEL.lineHeightFp as number)
              .letterSpacing(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_LABEL.letterSpacingFp as number)
              .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_INK', this.appThemeScheme));
            Text('支持多选 TXT、EPUB、MOBI、AZW3')
              .fontFamily(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.fontFamily)
              .fontWeight(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.fontWeight)
              .fontSize(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.fontSizeFp)
              .lineHeight(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.lineHeightFp as number)
              .letterSpacing(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.letterSpacingFp as number)
              .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_MUTED', this.appThemeScheme))
              .margin({ top: 2 });
          }

Row({ space: TOK_SPACE_XS }) {
          Image((this.appThemeScheme === 'night' ? $r('app.media.import_info_theme_night') : $r('app.media.import_info')))
            .width(13)
            .height(13)
            .margin({ top: 2 });
          Text(this.failureMessage.length > 0 ? this.failureMessage : '支持从系统文件中多选 TXT、EPUB、MOBI 与 AZW3。')
            .layoutWeight(1)
            .fontFamily(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.fontFamily)
            .fontWeight(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.fontWeight)
            .fontSize(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.fontSizeFp)
            .lineHeight(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.lineHeightFp as number)
            .letterSpacing(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.letterSpacingFp as number)
            .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_MUTED', this.appThemeScheme));
        }
Text(this.failureMessage.length > 0 ? this.failureMessage : '支持从系统文件中多选 TXT、EPUB、MOBI 与 AZW3。')

Column({ space: 1 }) {
          Text(this.summaryTitle())
            .fontFamily(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_LABEL.fontFamily)
            .fontWeight(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_LABEL.fontWeight)
            .fontSize(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_LABEL.fontSizeFp)
            .lineHeight(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_LABEL.lineHeightFp as number)
            .letterSpacing(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_LABEL.letterSpacingFp as number)
            .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_INK', this.appThemeScheme));
          Text(this.resultCountText())
            .fontFamily(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.fontFamily)
            .fontWeight(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.fontWeight)
            .fontSize(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.fontSizeFp)
            .lineHeight(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.lineHeightFp as number)
            .letterSpacing(TYPE_FILE_IMPORT_HINT.letterSpacingFp as number)
            .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_MUTED', this.appThemeScheme));
        }

Row() {
      Text('书源')
        .width(this.sourceHeaderWidth())
        .height(12)
        .fontFamily(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_COLUMN.fontFamily)
        .fontWeight(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_COLUMN.fontWeight)
        .fontSize(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_COLUMN.fontSizeFp)
        .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_READ_HANDLE', this.appThemeScheme))
        .margin({ left: 10 });

      Text('延迟')
        .width(72)
        .height(12)
        .fontFamily(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_COLUMN.fontFamily)
        .fontWeight(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_COLUMN.fontWeight)
        .fontSize(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_COLUMN.fontSizeFp)
        .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_READ_HANDLE', this.appThemeScheme));

      Text('当前章节')
        .width(100)
        .height(12)
        .fontFamily(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_COLUMN.fontFamily)
        .fontWeight(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_COLUMN.fontWeight)
        .fontSize(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_COLUMN.fontSizeFp)
        .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_READ_HANDLE', this.appThemeScheme))
        .textAlign(TextAlign.End);
    }
Text(isSwitching ? '正在切换书源…' : '正在搜索书源…')

Column({ space: 0 }) {
      Blank().layoutWeight(1);
      Text('书源搜索失败')
        .fontFamily(TYPE_SOURCE_STATE_TITLE.fontFamily)
        .fontWeight(TYPE_SOURCE_STATE_TITLE.fontWeight)
        .fontSize(TYPE_SOURCE_STATE_TITLE.fontSizeFp)
        .lineHeight(TYPE_SOURCE_STATE_TITLE.lineHeightFp as number)
        .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_INK', this.appThemeScheme))
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center);
      Text(message)
        .margin({ top: TOK_SPACE_XS })
        .width(this.messageWidth())
        .fontFamily(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_MESSAGE.fontFamily)
        .fontWeight(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_MESSAGE.fontWeight)
        .fontSize(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_MESSAGE.fontSizeFp)
        .lineHeight(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_MESSAGE.lineHeightFp as number)
        .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_MUTED', this.appThemeScheme))
        .maxLines(2)
        .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center);
      Text('重试')
        .margin({ top: 18 })
        .fontFamily(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_RECOVERY.fontFamily)
        .fontWeight(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_RECOVERY.fontWeight)
        .fontSize(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_RECOVERY.fontSizeFp)
        .lineHeight(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_RECOVERY.lineHeightFp as number)
        .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_MUTED', this.appThemeScheme))
        .padding({ left: 26, right: 26, top: TOK_SPACE_SM, bottom: TOK_SPACE_SM })
        .backgroundColor(readerAppColor('TOK_CARD_BG', this.appThemeScheme))
        .border({ width: TOK_BORDER_W, color: readerAppColor('TOK_BORDER', this.appThemeScheme) })
        .borderRadius(999)
        .onClick((): void => this.onRetry());
      Blank().layoutWeight(1);
    }

Column({ space: 0 }) {
      Blank().layoutWeight(1);
      Text('换源失败')
        .fontFamily(TYPE_SOURCE_STATE_TITLE.fontFamily)
        .fontWeight(TYPE_SOURCE_STATE_TITLE.fontWeight)
        .fontSize(TYPE_SOURCE_STATE_TITLE.fontSizeFp)
        .lineHeight(TYPE_SOURCE_STATE_TITLE.lineHeightFp as number)
        .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_INK', this.appThemeScheme))
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center);
      Text(message)
        .margin({ top: TOK_SPACE_XS })
        .width(this.messageWidth())
        .fontFamily(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_MESSAGE.fontFamily)
        .fontWeight(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_MESSAGE.fontWeight)
        .fontSize(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_MESSAGE.fontSizeFp)
        .lineHeight(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_MESSAGE.lineHeightFp as number)
        .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_MUTED', this.appThemeScheme))
        .maxLines(2)
        .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center);
      if (canRollback) {
        Text('撤销切换')
          .margin({ top: 18 })
          .fontFamily(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_RECOVERY.fontFamily)
          .fontWeight(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_RECOVERY.fontWeight)
          .fontSize(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_RECOVERY.fontSizeFp)
          .lineHeight(TYPE_SOURCE_SWITCH_RECOVERY.lineHeightFp as number)
          .fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_MUTED', this.appThemeScheme))
          .padding({ left: 26, right: 26, top: TOK_SPACE_SM, bottom: TOK_SPACE_SM })
          .backgroundColor(readerAppColor('TOK_CARD_BG', this.appThemeScheme))
          .border({ width: TOK_BORDER_W, color: readerAppColor('TOK_BORDER', this.appThemeScheme) })
          .borderRadius(999)
          .onClick((): void => this.onRollback());
      }
      Blank().layoutWeight(1);
    }

Text(this.state.errorMessage || this.localError || (this.state.status === 'loading' || this.state.status === 'idle' ?
        '规则载入中…' : this.emptyStateMessage()))

Text(this.layer === 'editor' ? (this.draft.original === undefined ? '新增替换规则' : '编辑替换规则') :
          this.layer === 'delete' ? '确认删除规则' : this.layer === 'import-confirm' ? '确认导入替换规则' : '当前章节预览')
Text(`删除“${this.deleteCandidate?.name ?? ''}”？此操作需要 Core 确认后才从列表移除。`)
Text('导入仅合并替换规则；相同ID会覆盖已有规则，其他规则集合不变。请保留导出备份。')

Row({ space: 8 }) {
      Text('取消').fontFamily(TYPE_READER_REPLACE_RETAINED_EDITOR_ACTIONS_CANCEL.fontFamily as string).fontSize(TYPE_READER_REPLACE_RETAINED_EDITOR_ACTIONS_CANCEL.fontSizeFp).fontColor(readerAppColor('TOK_READ_INK', this.appThemeScheme))
        .layoutWeight(1).height(36).textAlign(TextAlign.Center).borderRadius(6)
        .backgroundColor(readerAppColor('TOK_SURFACE_PANEL_SOFT', this.appThemeScheme))
        .border({ width: TOK_BORDER_W, color: readerAppColor('TOK_LINE', this.appThemeScheme) })
        .enabled(!this.localPending && !this.state.mutationPending)
        .onClick((): void => this.cancelTemporaryLayer());
      Text('保存').fontFamily(TYPE_READER_REPLACE_RETAINED_EDITOR_ACTIONS_SAVE.fontFamily as string).fontSize(TYPE_READER_REPLACE_RETAINED_EDITOR_ACTIONS_SAVE.fontSizeFp)
        .fontColor(readerAppColor('app.ReaderControlReplaceContent.toolbarButton.fontColor.FFFFFFFF', this.appThemeScheme))
        .layoutWeight(1).height(36).textAlign(TextAlign.Center).borderRadius(6)
        .backgroundColor(readerAppColor('TOK_READ_PRIMARY', this.appThemeScheme))
        .enabled(this.fullInput() && this.readyInput())
        .onClick((): void => { this.saveEditor(); });
    }
Text('保存后规则生效；章节预览使用已保存规则。')
Text(`已保存 ${this.previewResult.storedRuleCount} 条，启用 ${this.previewResult.enabledRuleCount} 条${this.previewResult.truncated ? '；仅展示截取片段' : ''}`)
TextInput({ placeholder: '例如 Azure 语音', text: this.draftName })
TextInput({ placeholder: '填入访问密钥', text: this.draftApiKey })
Text(this.draftClearApiKey ? '将清除已保存密钥' : '清除已保存密钥')
TextInput({ placeholder: '例如 xiaoxiao', text: this.draftVoice })
